item.title: security: Security for the agentic era, powered by Microsoft Perception
item.description:
Microsoft announced updates to Microsoft Perception and a new Microsoft Security cyber stack aimed at defending against threats, securing agents, and protecting digital estates. The post frames these changes as security measures for an “agentic era.”

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
